THE GOLF HEIST · ChatGPT prompt pack (episodes 2 to 6)
=======================================================

HOW TO USE
1. Start a new ChatGPT chat. Attach the three reference pictures
   (reference-him.jpg, reference-her.jpg, reference-living-room.jpg).
2. Paste the STYLE + CHARACTERS block below first, then one panel prompt at a time.
3. Every panel: PORTRAIT (tall, 1024 x 1536). If one comes out square or wide, ask:
   "Same image, but tall portrait 1024x1536."
4. Check each one: NO words, letters, speech bubbles, logos or brand names anywhere
   (I add the narration boxes and bubbles myself). Phone and receipt screens stay blank or blurred.
5. Name the files like this and send them over: heist-02-1.png, heist-02-2.png ... heist-06-4.png


STYLE + CHARACTERS (paste this first)
-------------------------------------
I'm making a comic series called The Golf Heist. Match the attached reference pictures exactly:
the same two characters, the same art style and the same house.

Style: comic-book illustration, bold clean ink outlines, flat cel shading with soft gradients,
moody cinematic lighting (cool blue shadows, warm amber lamplight), vertical portrait 1024x1536.
Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, logos or brand names anywhere in the picture.

HIM: man in his mid-30s, short dark-brown hair swept up, full short dark beard, navy-blue hoodie,
grey joggers, white trainers. Very expressive guilty eyebrows.

HER: woman in her mid-30s, long dark-brown hair, sunglasses pushed up on her head, dark green
ribbed quarter-zip jumper, dark jeans, white trainers. Usually arms folded with a raised eyebrow;
a sly little smile when she wins.

THE HOUSE: cosy UK terraced house. Narrow blue-lit hallway with wooden floorboards, a living
room with a brown armchair, a table lamp and a golf bag in the corner.

Reply "ready" and I'll send the panels one at a time.


EPISODE 2 · THE BALL DRAWER
---------------------------
02-1  Night. HIM tiptoeing along the dark hallway towards the bedroom, hugging a bulging mesh bag
      full of white golf balls, looking over his shoulder. Blue light, long shadows.
02-2  Close-up from above: an open bedroom sock drawer completely full of white golf balls, not a
      single sock in it. HIS hand frozen mid-air, about to drop one more ball in.
02-3  HER standing in the bedroom doorway, holding up one sad, lonely odd sock, eyebrow raised,
      lamplight behind her. HIM in the foreground, caught, eyes wide.
02-4  Close-up of HER, sly smile, holding three golf balls up in one hand like a trophy, a golf
      glove sticking out of her jumper pocket.

EPISODE 3 · THE DELIVERY
------------------------
03-1  Daytime at the front door. HER signing for a long cardboard parcel. The delivery driver is
      seen only from behind, plain grey uniform, no logos. She's grinning at the box.
03-2  HER at the kitchen table, shaking the long box next to her ear, narrowed eyes, mischievous grin.
03-3  HIM coming in the front door with keys in hand, frozen in the hallway, staring at the opened,
      empty box on the floor. Shocked face.
03-4  Living room: HER on the armchair aiming a small golf rangefinder at the sofa like a sniper,
      very pleased with herself. HIM in the background, hand on his forehead.

EPISODE 4 · THE RECEIPT
-----------------------
04-1  Hallway. HER pulling a long paper receipt out of the side pocket of a golf bag, holding it up
      to the light. The paper is blank or blurred: no readable writing.
04-2  HIM on the sofa, super confident, pointing at his phone screen (the screen just glows, no
      readable text), big smug grin.
04-3  HER nodding, impressed, receipt in hand, one eyebrow raised in grudging respect.
04-4  HER pulling a SECOND, enormously long receipt out of the golf bag; it unrolls all the way
      across the floor. HIM in the background, sinking down into the sofa. (Paper blank or blurred.)

EPISODE 5 · THE EARLY TEE TIME
------------------------------
05-1  6am, blue pre-dawn light. HIM creeping down the stairs in socks, golf bag on his shoulder,
      trainers in his hand, holding his breath.
05-2  Outside on a misty driveway at dawn. HIM easing the car door open very quietly, golf bag
      over his shoulder, looking back at the dark house. Car has no badges or logos.
05-3  Inside the car: HER already sitting in the passenger seat in a waterproof golf jacket and a
      bobble hat, holding two takeaway coffees, looking straight at him, deadpan.
05-4  Close-up of HER, sly smile, holding up her phone (blank glowing screen). HIM beside her,
      laughing in defeat, head back against the seat.

EPISODE 6 · THE CHRISTMAS LIST (for December)
---------------------------------------------
06-1  Christmas morning, living room, tree with warm lights. HER handing HIM a long wrapped present
      with a red bow. He looks delighted.
06-2  HIM with the wrapping paper torn open, holding a plain long box (no brand), his smile freezing
      into panic.
06-3  The hallway cupboard door ajar, showing the identical plain long box hidden inside behind
      the coats. Cool blue light, dramatic.
06-4  Both of them laughing together on the sofa by the tree, HER holding the present box, HIM with
      his face in his hands, laughing.


If you only have time for one episode first, do Episode 5 (The Early Tee Time).
